item.title: FinCEN and the Fed scrap the $250 Travel Rule plan—$3,000 threshold stays
item.description: FinCEN and the Fed withdrew a 2020 proposal to cut the cross-border Travel Rule threshold from $3,000 to $250.

item.title: Bitcoin loses its 50-week moving average as long liquidations top $1 billion
item.description: Bitcoin closed below its ~$75,488 50-week average after seven weeks above it, as liquidations topped $1.15B.

item.title: PNC Bank pilots USDC payments with Coinbase for corporate clients
item.description: PNC launched a limited USDC incoming-payments pilot with Coinbase for eligible corporate clients.

item.title: Bitcoin’s weekend whipsaw: $1B liquidated as Nvidia headlines hit risk assets
item.description: BTC briefly slipped to ~$73,761 before reclaiming $75,000 amid more than $1B in leveraged liquidations.

item.title: How to buy your first Bitcoin on Coinbase (U.S. beginner guide)
item.description: Step-by-step U.S. beginner walkthrough: create an account, verify, fund, and place a small first Bitcoin buy on Coinbase.

item.title: After the midterms: ETF outflows and a tougher crypto rulebook ahead?
item.description: Spot bitcoin ETFs saw about $1.28B in weekly outflows as markets digest a Democratic midterm sweep and talk of a bigger SEC role.
